source.title: Some open problems of matroid theory, suggested by its applications.

evidence.quote: The paper presents 18 problems in matroid theory which were unsolved as of 1982. Many of them arise from a practical background or are related to algorithmic questions of matroid theory.

trace.notes: Mapped the zbMATH resolver page. The page exposes bibliographic metadata, reviewer summary text, classification, and a review-PDF link, but not the underlying article text or the 18 problem statements themselves.

No candidate questions were extracted because the chosen readable source is only a bibliographic/review page. The visible summary states that the paper contains 18 unsolved problems but does not reproduce them verbatim.

Failed source adequacy gate: extracting problem statements from bibliographic metadata or review summaries would introduce unsupported content. Exact-work recovery attempts via title-based web search surfaced a different later paper and other secondary references, but no readable exact-work full text for the 1985 Colloq. Math. Soc. János Bolyai 40 article.
